stem_book: A wheel of radius R rolls without slipping (to the right) over a rough surface and its centre O moves with constant acceleration 'a'. Find the acceleration of the given points O (centre), P (contact point), Q (topmost point) and S (rightmost point) when the velocity of the centre of the wheel is 'v' (ω = v/R; î to the right, ĵ upward).
key: aO = aî; aP = ω²Rĵ; aQ = 2aî − ω²Rĵ; aS = (a − ω²R)î − aĵ

correct_answer: aO = aî; aP = (v²/R)ĵ; aQ = 2aî − (v²/R)ĵ; aS = (a − v²/R)î − aĵ
